kind: analyze (formation energy, ground-state ordering, relaxed lattice)
provenance: Values from our 3_reproduction/L2/result.json. Raw staged energies reproduce the stored formation energies within the existing 10% tolerance; 50L21_50XA_cfg1 differs by 2.25625 meV/atom, so an all-rows <1 meV claim is not valid. Ground-truth values are retained.

tolerances.note: Every E_f within +/-10% relative with sign; lowest_E_ordering must be XA and a minimum of the submitted six-value table (tied minima allowed); endpoint lattice constants within +/-10%.

score: 1 only if all six formation energies and both lattice constants pass their unchanged 10% bands, the lowest-energy label is XA, and its submitted value is a table minimum (ties allowed).
